faq.metaDescription: Answers to the most frequent questions about booking, listing billboards, and payments.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know to book, list, or manage a billboard on Guen's Pub.
faq.q1: How do I book a billboard?
faq.a1: Browse our catalog of available billboards, pick the one that fits your campaign, then follow the booking flow from your advertiser space.
faq.q2: How do I become a billboard owner on the platform?
faq.a2: Create an account, then fill in the "Become an owner" form with your company details. Once approved, you can list your billboards and track your bookings.
faq.q3: How does payment and the wallet work?
faq.a3: Every user has a wallet to deposit and withdraw funds. Booking payments and payouts to owners flow through this wallet.
faq.q4: What does a media buyer do?
faq.a4: A media buyer can complete a payment on behalf of an advertiser who mandated them, and tracks their commissions from their dedicated space.
faq.q5: Which countries is Guen's Pub present in?
faq.a5: The platform lists billboards across several countries in West and Central Africa, as well as France. The list of available countries grows as new billboards are added.
faq.q6: How do I track or cancel a booking?
faq.a6: Go to "My bookings" from your advertiser space: you'll find the status of each booking and the actions available.
faq.a7: Email us at contact@guenspub.com or use the form on the Contact page; our team replies within 24 to 48 business hours.
